line: Hey {{playerName}}, glad you stopped to listen in {{city}}. What do you think of the song?
Welcome to {{city}}, {{playerName}}! Catch that last tune?

choices.text: Your music in {{city}} is amazing. Keep the change!
feedback: The musician smiles, {{playerName}}, and points you toward a quieter path in Central Park.
The musician nods. That tip earned you a local route through {{city}}.
choices.journalLabel: You complimented the musician and left a tip.

choices.text: That song is beautiful. Thank you!
choices.feedback: The musician thanks you and teaches you a friendly way to praise a performance.

choices.text: I have to go, but I enjoyed the music. Take care!
choices.feedback: The musician waves goodbye. You can come back another time.
choices.journalLabel: You said goodbye to the musician.

choices.text: I'm busy. Just point me to the next place.
choices.feedback: The musician looks annoyed and goes back to the song.

line: Excuse me! I'm trying to find the subway. Could you help me?

choices.text: Here, take my subway map. It will help you find the station.
choices.feedback: The tourist thanks you and gives you a theater ticket they no longer need.
choices.journalLabel: You shared your subway map with a traveler.

choices.text: Walk toward the park exit and follow the signs to the subway.
choices.feedback: The tourist thanks you for the directions.

choices.text: I'm not sure, but I hope you find it!
choices.feedback: The tourist smiles and asks another passerby.
choices.journalLabel: You wished a traveler good luck.

line: Evening! The city sounds different at dusk, doesn't it?

choices.text: It does. Would you play one more song?
choices.feedback: The musician plays a short tune and teaches you a warm way to ask for more.
choices.journalLabel: You listened to a jazz musician at dusk.

choices.text: It does. Thanks for sharing the music!
choices.feedback: The musician nods and wishes you a safe walk.
